recommendation.personalized_diet_plan: Based on your profile as an active 20-year-old female with a non-vegetarian Indian dietary preference and a moderate overall health risk, your nutrition plan is designed to optimize heart health, support stable blood sugar levels, ensure adequate micronutrient intake (especially Vitamin D, B12, Iron, Calcium), and maintain energy for your active lifestyle, while strictly avoiding nuts due to your allergy. foods_to_include: Whole Grains: Brown rice, whole wheat roti/chapati, oats, quinoa, millets (bajra, jowar, ragi).
Lean Proteins: Chicken (skinless), fish (salmon, mackerel, sardines for omega-3s), eggs, paneer, lentils (dal), chickpeas (chana), kidney beans (rajma), tofu, soy chunks.
Healthy Fats: Ghee (in moderation), mustard oil, olive oil, avocado, flax seeds (ground for omega-3s).
Fruits: Berries, apples, bananas, oranges, guavas, mangoes (in season, portion-controlled), papayas.
Vegetables: A wide variety of seasonal Indian vegetables including leafy greens (spinach, fenugreek leaves), broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, bell peppers, gourds, okra, eggplant.

Dairy & Alternatives: Low-fat milk, yogurt (dahi), buttermilk, fortified plant-based milks (almond milk is usually nut-based, so ensure it's a nut-free alternative if used, e.g., soy or oat milk), paneer (low-fat where possible).
Spices & Herbs: Turmeric, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, curry leaves (for flavor and antioxidant benefits).
Hydration: Water, coconut water, herbal teas, buttermilk.
foods_to_avoid: Nuts and Nut Products: Absolutely avoid all nuts (almonds, cashews, peanuts, walnuts, etc.) and products containing them, including nut flours, nut butters, and certain Indian sweets or gravies that use cashew or almond paste. Always check food labels diligently.
Refined Grains: White bread, white rice (minimize), sugary cereals, pastries.
Excessive Saturated and Trans Fats: Deep-fried foods, excessive amounts of ghee or butter, highly processed snacks, margarine.
Added Sugars: Sugary beverages, sweets, desserts, candies, processed fruit juices.
Highly Processed Foods: Packaged snacks, fast food, instant noodles.
Excessive Sodium: Processed foods, pickles (consume in moderation), papad.

lifestyle_advice: Stay Hydrated: Aim for at least 8-10 glasses of water daily to support all bodily functions and energy levels.
Prioritize Sleep: Ensure 7-9 hours of quality sleep each night, as it's crucial for recovery, hormone balance, and overall well-being, especially with an active lifestyle.
Mindful Eating: Practice eating slowly, savoring your meals, and paying attention to your body's hunger and fullness cues to support healthy digestion and portion control.

Sun Exposure for Vitamin D: Safely expose yourself to morning sunlight for 15-20 minutes a few times a week, when possible, to support Vitamin D synthesis. Consult your doctor for personalized advice on sun exposure and potential supplementation.
Label Reading for Allergies: Always meticulously check food labels for 'nuts' or 'may contain nuts' to prevent accidental exposure.
Stress Management: Incorporate stress-reducing activities like yoga, meditation, deep breathing, or hobbies into your routine, as stress can impact various health markers.

Consistent Activity: Continue your active lifestyle, aiming for a mix of cardiovascular exercise, strength training, and flexibility to support muscle health, bone density, and cardiovascular well-being.
